channel.title: What NBA players and coaches have said about James Worthy | HoopsMatic
channel.description: The latest quotes about James Worthy from NBA players, coaches and executives, with context and sources.

item.title: Byron Scott on James Worthy, AC Green
item.description:
Scott recalled,laughing again.

“But it got us going. The next week, I was like, ‘I’ve got to start getting ready now!’ Instead of taking two or three weeks off like I normally do, I had to get ready now because he guaranteed it and we got to be ready. I went on the track and I saw Magic out there. I saw A.C. [Green] out there. James [Worthy] out there.”

Byron Scott on James Worthy, AC Green, Sep 30, 2020. Source: Los Angeles Times.

item.title: Danny Green on LeBron James, James Worthy, Anthony Davis
item.description:
Green said as he started his list.

“I’m gonna go withMagic at one, Kobe at two, LeBron at three, A.D. (Anthony Davis) at four, and a lot of people aren’t going to like this, but I’m going to go with Big Game James (James Worthy) at five.”

Danny Green on LeBron James, James Worthy, Anthony Davis, Mar 18, 2020. Source: Clutch Points.

item.title: Kevin Durant on James Worthy
item.description:
Durant then shared the following story:

“We played in Vancouver, first game in a Warriors uniform. And I see James Worthy walking out as I was leaving the game ... it's a legend here. 'Big Game James.' I didn't get to see him play but I just know all about him ... I'm a little skeptical at this point to even talk to anybody from the generation before because I don't even know how they feel about me as a person, as a player because these dudes -- they look at me as like, 'Oh you switching teams, you chasing this, you chasing that.' So I'm just gonna keep it moving.”

Kevin Durant on James Worthy, Apr 4, 2017. Source: CSNBayArea.com.

item.title: Kevin Durant on James Worthy
item.description:
“So I came back home that night and my boy Randy (Williams) — I was like: ‘Man. James Worthy was cool. He showed me so much love. I appreciate that,'”

Kevin Durant on James Worthy, Mar 31, 2017. Source: San Jose Mercury-News.

item.title: Pat Riley on Erik Spoelstra, Magic Johnson, Kareem Abdul-Jabbar, James Worthy
item.description:
“He’s a lot like me. The first time I got my Coach of the Year award I was embarrassed to go and get it because I got it with a team behind me of Kareem Abdul-Jabbar, Magic Johnson, James Worthy, etc.That residual reward will come to [Spoelstra]. The ones that he has that are more important to him are the ones that he’s wearing on his fingers.”

Pat Riley on Erik Spoelstra, Magic Johnson, Kareem Abdul-Jabbar, James Worthy, Mar 9, 2017. Source: Palm Beach Post.

item.title: Kareem Abdul-Jabbar on James Worthy
item.description:
Abdul-Jabbar on how centers should play today:

“When you can post up and shoot 3-pointers, you have that versatility that enables you to win games. I remember playing with teammates like James Worthy who had that type of versatility, could shoot and jump shoot and post up. I think that a little something is being lost there as we go away from a lot of post-up moves. But post-up players take high-percentage shots, high-percentage shots win games. You saw what happened to Golden State when they stopped making the 3-pointers. They lost three games in a row and lost the world championship. So the 3-pointer isn’t the answer to everything.”

Kareem Abdul-Jabbar on James Worthy, Nov 13, 2016. Source: Boston Globe.

item.title: Pat Riley on James Worthy, Jamaal Wilkes, Justise Winslow
item.description:
“I remember when James Worthy came to the Lakers and Jamaal Wilkes was the incumbent and then there came that time, there came that time when it was just a matter of time when James Worthy was going to take his position. Are we ready for Justise Winslow to start at the three? I am. I’m not just throwing him out there. This guy has been thrown out there last year and played significant minutes and significant time. I trust him. So you guys put too much on the things that he can’t do versus what he can. And those things that he can’t do, he’s going to be able to do better with more minutes.”

Pat Riley on James Worthy, Jamaal Wilkes, Justise Winslow, Jul 25, 2016. Source: Palm Beach Post.

item.title: Kobe Bryant on James Worthy
item.description:
Mike Trudell:Kobe on @James Worthy hire:

“Extremely smart move. We're an organization that's fortunate to have some all-time greats. Gotta use that.”

Kobe Bryant on James Worthy, Sep 28, 2015. Source: Twitter @LakersReporter.
